entities.name: Nicolás Brussino
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nicolás "Nico" Brussino is an Argentine-Italian professional basketball player for Gran Canaria of the Spanish Liga ACB. He also represents the senior Argentine national team in international competition. Standing at 2.01 m, he plays at the small forward position.
